name: Ambubhai Purani Award
nodalDept: Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department
briefDescription: The scheme "Ambubhai Purani Award" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Gujarat, aims to recognize outstanding contributions in the field of gymnasiums (Akhadas) through the conferment of the Gymnasium Jyotirdhar Ambubhai Purani Award and financial assistance of ₹51,000/-.
descriptionMd: The scheme &quot;Ambubhai Purani Award&quot; by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to promote the development of gymnasiums and traditional Indian physical culture by honoring individuals who have shown exceptional contribution in this field. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹51,000/- and state-level recognition to outstanding individuals, fostering motivation and continuity in preserving indigenous physical training traditions. The scheme is implemented by the Sports Authority of Gujarat.
eligibilityMd: 1. The applicant should be a male individual. 1. The applicant should have performed excellent work in the field of Gymnasiums (Akhadas).
applicationMd: > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the official homepage of the [Sports Authority of Gujarat](https://sportsauthority.gujarat.gov.in/). **Step 2:** On the homepage, navigate to the Player Registration option after clicking on the "Register" button in the top-right corner. **Step 3:** Fill out the Player Registration Form with the required personal details and click on "Register". **Step 4:** After completion, the login ID and password information will be shared via email. <br> > **Login and Application Process:** **Step 1:** Go to the [Login page](https://sportsauthority.gujarat.gov.in/login) and select the user type as "Player". **Step 2:** Log in using the credentials received via email. **Step 3:** After logging in, select the concerned scheme. **Step 4:** Fill in the required details and upload documents as required. Click on "Submit" to apply. <br> > **Contact Us:** Director General, Sports Authority of Gujarat Sport, Youth & Cultural Activities Department Administrative Building, Sector 13-B, Near Kh-3 Circle, Near Vavol Railway Crossing, Beside EVM warehouse, Gandhinagar - 382016 Contact Number-97140 97760
